headline: Blanked, but with chances
record_line: Yesterday: 0-4 on the top plays · Season: 17-81

entries.headline: Cal Raleigh stayed in the yard
entries.story: Cal Raleigh went 0-for-4 against Max Fried and the New York Yankees. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Wilyer Abreu stayed in the yard
entries.story: Wilyer Abreu went 1-for-3 with 2 BB against Max Scherzer and the Toronto Blue Jays. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Ben Rice stayed in the yard
entries.story: Ben Rice went 0-for-3 with 1 BB against Logan Gilbert and the Seattle Mariners. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Shohei Ohtani did not appear
entries.story: Shohei Ohtani was scratched or never got in the game, so the pick carries over as a no-action.

entries.headline: Willson Contreras came close
entries.story: Willson Contreras went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Max Scherzer and the Toronto Blue Jays. Closest call was a double in the 1st: "Willson Contreras doubles (19) on a line drive to right fielder Nathan Lukes. Wilyer Abreu scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.
